screen.fpstune.title: FPS Tune
screen.fpstune.description: Choose a simple way to make busy scenes feel smoother. Press Done to save.
screen.fpstune.advanced.title: FPS Tune: Advanced settings
screen.fpstune.advanced.description: Fine-tune particle effects. Press Back to return; use Done on the main screen to save.
option.fpstune.enabled.tooltip: Turn on FPS Tune's local visual changes. Off by default.
option.fpstune.profile.help: Profiles only change how many particle effects are shown. Use Advanced settings for individual controls.
option.fpstune.weather_rendering.tooltip: Show the normal rain and snow effects. Turning this off hides only their local visuals.
option.fpstune.diagnostics_hud.tooltip: Show local counters and the current particle limit while you play. Off by default.
button.fpstune.advanced.tooltip: Adjust individual particle limits and automatic performance settings.
option.fpstune.particle_admission.toolti: Limit new particle effects during busy scenes while FPS Tune is enabled.
option.fpstune.max_particles.tooltip: Maximum new particle effects allowed during a busy scene.
option.fpstune.nearby_priority.tooltip: Keep some room for effects near you so distant effects are reduced first.
option.fpstune.nearby_reserve.tooltip: How many particle effects near you are protected when the limit is reached.
option.fpstune.nearby_distance.tooltip: How far from you an effect can be and still count as nearby.
option.fpstune.adaptive_budget.tooltip: Lower or raise the particle limit slowly to stay near your target FPS. Off by default.
button.fpstune.reset.tooltip: Restore every FPS Tune option to its default. Changes apply when you press Done.
